context.problem_statement: Detect the dominant frequency components in a periodic sensor signal using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). The signal is sampled at 1000 Hz. Steps: (1) compute FFT using numpy.fft.fft, (2) compute the corresponding frequency bins using numpy.fft.fftfreq, (3) compute the power spectrum (magnitude squared of FFT), (4) identify the top 3 peak frequencies in the positive frequency half of the spectrum, (5) report the amplitude of each frequency component (amplitude = 2 * |FFT[k]| / N for k > 0), (6) verify by reconstructing the signal from the top 3 components and computing reconstruction error (RMSE).
context.expert_knowledge: FFT of N samples: fft = np.fft.fft(signal). Frequencies: freqs = np.fft.fftfreq(N, d=1/sample_rate). Power spectrum: power = np.abs(fft)**2. Only analyze positive frequencies (first N//2 points). Amplitude = 2*np.abs(fft[:N//2])/N. Peak detection: scipy.signal.find_peaks on power spectrum. Nyquist frequency = sample_rate/2. Resolution = sample_rate/N Hz.
